bull_bear.body:
- Integrated business model from fabric sourcing/wholesale through to branded retail, enabling consistent quality, style and value across the value chain
- Established brands Urban United and YARD with an expanding exclusive retail outlet network (16 retail outlets across the country per Chairman's message) plus a new large-format YARD store in Ahmedabad
- Positioned as a preferred fabric wholesale partner for fashion designers, apparel manufacturers and retailers on the strength of consistent quality and an extensive product portfolio
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Raw material and fabric price volatility — Company flags volatility in raw material and fabric prices as a business risk it continues to monitor, given its dependence on sourced fabrics for garment manufacturing.
- Intense competition from domestic and international apparel brands — Organised menswear retail (Urban United, YARD) competes against both domestic and international branded players, pressuring market share and pricing.
- Rapidly changing fashion trends and customer preferences — As a branded fashion retailer, misjudging trend shifts can lead to inventory and merchandising risk.
- Inflationary pressures affecting consumer spending — Discretionary apparel demand is sensitive to inflation-driven declines in consumer purchasing power.
- Supply chain disruptions and logistics costs — Company cites supply chain disruption and rising logistics costs as risks to its retail and wholesale fabric operations.
- Foreign exchange fluctuations impacting sourcing — Sourcing of fabrics from domestic and international suppliers exposes the Company to FX movements.
- Increasing compliance and regulatory requirements — Company flags a rising compliance/regulatory burden as an operating risk it must manage.
- Key-management turnover — The Company saw multiple senior changes during the year, including the CFO/Executive Director's resignation (13 Feb 2026) and two Company Secretary changes, which can strain governance continuity.

outlook.body: The Company continues to expand its exclusive retail outlet network across multiple states, operating 16 retail outlets across the country under the Urban United and YARD brands. It has launched a new large-format YARD retail concept, with a newly developed large-format YARD store in Ahmedabad, aimed at strengthening its presence in organised value retail.
